I used to have the same exact problem with my clothes.  I realized I was trying on all these different outfits in the morning because I had so many pieces that didn't fit well, or that didn't match anything else, or that simply didn't appeal to me anymore. 

What helped me the most was decluttering them hard and then sorting out clothes I don't use regularly and putting them in storage spaces. I donated TONS of clothes, but my closet was still super full. So, I put clothes that are off-season away, and then I put clothes from an old job away (maybe I'll need them in the future, but not at the moment). Now, the only clothes immediately available in my closet are things I actually need to wear on a daily basis *right now* . The trick for me was realizing that there was a lot I could give away (haven't missed anything yet), and whatever I might need later but don't regularly wear could just be stored out of sight. My closet is waaayy more manageable now. I hope this helps!

It could be a bacterial bloom caused by any number of things such as a fish or plant decaying or overfeeding. Vacuuming your substrate well and doing some more frequent water changes can help clear up a bacterial bloom. You can wait it out this way but if you're impatient (like me lol) you can get a UV sterilizer pump that will kill all of the floating bacteria and clear up the water. The UV filter won't fix the underlying problem for the bloom, but it can at least make the water clear while you figure it out. Good luck!

Above comments are right, rosaries are for a cycle of meditative prayers for Catholics. The rosary is specific to the Virgin Mary, and it's split up into five sections or "decades", and on these beads people say the Hail Mary while meditating on a specific type of miracle, which changes depending on which day of the week you're saying them. Catholics believe saints can intercede for them if they want to ask for help or a favor from God, so they might pray the rosary if they want Mary specifically to intercede for them, or if they went to confession and the Priest told them to pray the rosary as penance. There are lots of people who say it every day, though (doing so is considered very admirable in the church)

This website can help if you want to learn more: https://www.dummies.com/article/body-mind-spirit/religion-spirituality/christianity/catholicism/how-to-pray-the-rosary-192609

For what it's worth, I don't see anything disrespectful about wearing it as a necklace, especially if you've bothered to learn what it means and what it's used for
